card.name: Counts of cases in trial statistics
card.fires_on: The word "in" right after a count of deaths or suicides ("four suicides in drug-treated patients") in antidepressant-style warning text. It also fires weakly on numbers and nouns inside event counts.

modes.label: Suicides in treated patients
modes.description: "in" after a stated number of suicides, just before the drug-treated group.
modes.example: There were four suicides<< in>> drug-treated patients in the trials and none

modes.label: Numbers in event rates
modes.description: A digit or count word inside a death or case tally from a trial.
modes.example: showed an increase in asthma-related deaths in patients receiving salmeterol (<<1>>3/13,176

modes.label: Usage statistics
modes.description: A noun in a per-month activity figure in general web text.
modes.example: On average, Facebook users create 90 pieces of<< content>> every month (Facebook 201
